description: Calculate position quantity and notional for a linear crypto futures trade from user-specified account balance, risk percentage, entry and stop. Includes separate entry/stop fees and optional target profit and net R. Direction is derived. Use when asked how much to buy or sell for a specified risk budget. Ask for missing prices or risk preference; do not invent them. Does not calculate liquidation, leverage, inverse contracts, exchange lot rounding, signals, or execute orders.

accountBalance.description: Account balance in the same quote currency as prices.

entryPrice.description: Planned entry price in quote currency per base unit.

fees.description: User-supplied rates. Omission explicitly assumes zero fees; no exchange rate lookup is performed.

entryPercent.description: Entry fee percent, e.g. 0.05 means 0.05%, not 5%.

targetPercent.description: Target exit fee percent; defaults to stopPercent.

instrumentType.description: Linear quote-margined instruments only. Inverse contracts and liquidation are unsupported.

quoteCurrency.description: Currency shared by all monetary inputs. Defaults to USD; no currency conversion is performed.

riskPercent.description: User-chosen account risk percentage, e.g. 1 means 1%. Never infer a risk preference.

stopPrice.description: Planned stop price. Direction is derived from entry and stop.

targetPrice.description: Optional profit target, opposite the stop relative to entry.

name: calculate_position_size
title: Fee-aware position size
